The house has dark green shutters on its numerous windows, a dark gray gabled roof, and a large wooden front door with an ornate transom and sidelights, accessed via a set of steps behind a black wrought-iron gate. A circular brick paver driveway with a herringbone pattern leads to the front of the house, encircling a manicured boxwood hedge island with a multi-tiered stone fountain at its center. The landscaping includes neatly trimmed green hedges along the property line and driveway, flowering pink and white bushes, and mature trees with Spanish moss hanging from their branches, all under bright daylight.

A winding flagstone pathway leads through natural, tall grasses and sparse trees towards the house, which is surrounded by a dense pine forest on the landward side. The ocean below is a deep blue, with white waves crashing against the rocks, and the sky above is a soft twilight purple, indicating either dawn or dusk.

The windows glow with warm interior lighting, indicating the house is illuminated from within. The sky above is a beautiful gradient of soft orange, pink, and blue hues, suggesting either sunrise or sunset, and the house is nestled against a backdrop of majestic red rock mountains.
